en.seg.label: Currency of the amounts

en.cta.message: To see net profit, enter the unit cost per product type and the shipping you pay per order once. They stay on this computer.

en.note.month_fallback: The month in the link ({asked}) cannot be shown, so the latest month, {month}, is open.
en.products.title: By product
en.products.sub.sales: Top {n} sellers · net = revenue − product cost
en.products.sub.profit: Top {n} by profit · net = revenue − product cost
en.products.sub.margin: Top {n} by margin · net = revenue − product cost

en.fees.title: Etsy fees breakdown
en.fees.ads_unknown: Ads are not part of the estimate
en.fees.reason.scope: Your Etsy connection cannot read orders, so fees are estimated from Etsy's standard rates.
en.fees.reason.forbidden: Etsy did not share the payment account ledger (403), so fees are estimated from standard rates.
en.fees.reason.unavailable: The Etsy payment account ledger could not be read ({status}), so fees are estimated from standard rates.
en.fees.reason.currency: Your payment account uses another currency and no rate was found, so fees are estimated from standard rates.

en.loading.message: Orders and Etsy fees are read month by month. The first time can take a while; after that it opens quickly.
